alt: A bar of the original 2901 graded targets shows the 2338 the fixed version keeps, plus 560 hidden compiler-made helpers and 3 placeholder statements it no longer scores, with callouts for two false statements and for a correct proof scoring one point less (25 against 26) when the omega tactic renames a helper.
caption: Two required statements were false and 560 hidden compiler-made helpers were graded, some in a way that depends on proof style; the fixed version corrects the statements and scores 2338 targets.
